label: EMAIL TIP
headline: Offer a preference center
body: Let subscribers choose their email topics and frequency to keep them engaged and reduce unsubscribes.
caption:
Your subscribers are unique, and their email preferences might be too! Giving them control over what kind of emails they receive and how often can make a big difference. It shows you respect their inbox and helps ensure they only get content they truly value, which means they're more likely to stay on your list.
